item.coloph: skyabs gnas g.yung drung gnas bzhi'i tshogs la skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshig gi sdeb sbyor/ chu dbang dgyes pa'i gter gyi rnam par rol pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba/ rang gi lus dang spyod pa rnam par shes pa'i rtog 'khrul dwangs byed pa/ gzhan gyi rang byed pa dang byas dang byas pas/ dam pa'i spyod pa mthong ba tshor bar gyur ba'i tshe/ shin tu ya nga ba dang skyi sha tsha ba gsal byed kyi dkyil 'khor chu yi khang pa'i dus/ skyabs mgon gyi yon tan ma lus pa nyid rnams legs par dran pa'i dpal las byung ba/ dmu rigs nyi ma'i ming can gyis khri brtan nor bu ngag snyan rtse'i gzims khang du brtsams pa/ dge ba'i dmigs yul gyi gtso byas khams gsum gyi sems can skyabs mgon de nyid ltar mdzad du gsol/ shing pho sprel gyi zla ba bdun pa'i tshes brgyad la dge'o//
